title: Moving to Carrollton in 1904
summary: He first lived uptown in Carrollton, having gone to New Orleans in 1904 as a valet after his father took him out of school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was going to ask another thing to change the subject. When you moved to New Orleans, just what part of town did you live in first?
I lived up in the 17 Ward.
Which streets? I don't remember those ward numbers.
Way uptown. Yes, sir. That's almost Carlton, I guess.
That is in Carlton. In Carlton. Yes, sir.
Did you and Pops live together? I think he told me he lived with the...

No, sir, I went down there first. I went down in 1904, October the 12th. Went down there as a valet. My father had taken me out of school and sent me down to the valet. What year did you went to the valet? Mr. McCaw, in 1904.
August the 12th. That's when I went down there.
